purpose: Gold-standard CORRECT state for the e-commerce fixture. Static HTML store with faceted-navigation, product-schema and CWV traps.

checks.desc: Canonical on category page pointing to clean URL; faceted params handled (no infinite crawl space)
Unique descriptive <title> per page (home != category, product not 'Product')
Unique meta description on every page
Exactly one <h1> per page, ordered heading descent
No crawlable duplicate URLs (?ref=, ?sort= permutations); pagination strategy defined
/llms.txt present and valid
/ai-agents.json present
Citation-ready product spec paragraphs (facts AI can quote)
Product FAQ blocks for AI answers
AI-readable primary-answer summary per page
Product schema complete: image, brand, offers w/ availability, aggregateRating
Schema price matches on-page price (no knowledge conflict)
Organization defined w/ stable @id (no dangling seller @id)
BreadcrumbList schema matching visual breadcrumb
CollectionPage/ItemList on category page
Optimized responsive images with dimensions (hero = LCP preload)
jQuery + webfont CSS not render-blocking (defer/async, font-display swap)
Below-the-fold product images lazy-loaded
JS-injected promo banner reserves space (no layout shift)
Self-hosted/preloaded font, no display:block webfont

scoring.note: Each category has 5 checks x 5 pts = 25. Full points when detected AND correct action; half when detected only; zero when missed.
